curve.name: BN254
curve.canonical_rule: inputs are 1-32 big-endian bytes, left-padded to a 32-byte big-endian field element; values >= scalar field modulus are rejected

hash.constants: 110 round constants: keccak256 iterated starting from keccak256("seed"), each digest reduced modulo the BN254 scalar field

merkle.node_rule: MiMC(left, right) per level; pathIndex 0 = current node is the left child, 1 = right child

identity_commitment: commitment = MiMC(identitySecret); identitySecret is 1-32 bytes, big-endian
external_nullifier: externalNullifier = hashToField(voteContext(chainID, domainName, issueName, suggestionName)); rating-independent, stable per suggestion
signal_hash: signalHash = hashToField(voteContext(chainID, domainName, issueName, suggestionName, rating)); binds chain, domain, issue, suggestion and the exact rating

vote_context_encoding.rating_encoding: int64 big-endian, appended only for the signal

vote_context_v2.purpose: GH-209 recipient-bound anonymous rating signal; the Groth16 SignalHash and the domain-key signature payload both cover this exact preimage
vote_context_v2.rating_encoding: int64 big-endian, appended after the four length-prefixed names
vote_context_v2.reward_recipient_encoding: canonical lowercase truerepublic bech32 address, uint32 big-endian length-prefixed, appended after the rating
vote_context_v2.external_nullifier: identical to the v1 scope; the one-vote nullifier stays recipient- and rating-independent

hash_to_field: SHA-256(data) as big-endian integer reduced modulo the BN254 scalar field, serialized as 32 big-endian bytes
exclusions: groth16.Setup samples random toxic waste: proving key, verifying key and proof bytes are NOT reproducible and MUST NOT be regenerated, compared or claimed as ceremony output
only the compiled constraint system is deterministic and pinned by byte/hash parity
no production ceremony, production prover, submission enablement, real keys/funds, deployment, release or network mutation
the v1 golden vector and fixture artifacts keep their exact historical bytes and semantics; GH-209 adds the recipient-bound v2 signal without modifying the circuit, CS, PK, VK, or the frozen v1 proof
direct payout publicly links the vote/nullifier event to the chosen payout address; fresh addresses reduce address-reuse linkage but do not create shielded payout privacy
